selection.selection: Minimum pooled active wrong-seed fraction on25 calibration sources; require at least half historical promotion count, mean IoU no more than.01 lower and mixing U no more than.02 higher. Ties IoU, rounds, policyID. Only modified policies. All constraints use calibration data only. Supplement added after primary calibration; no comparison outcomes used.
selection.confirmation: Use primary experiment confirmations wherever available; also confirm any supplementary endpoint failing convergence or ESS<100. Whole supplementary case bank replaced, never cherry-picked.
